goal: Generate a 1:1 square image featuring a full or half-body character with Minecraft voxel 3D feel, resembling Jensen Huang's signature style, for use as profile pictures in gaming communities or tech meme images.

character.subject: Voxel character with a body ratio of approximately 1:1.5, square face, black hair with a part, slightly square jaw.
character.outfit: Shiny black leather jacket with a large lapel (composed of square panels), deep gray T-shirt without text, deep denim jeans without branding, cubist-style leather shoes.
character.pose: One hand holds a cubic GPU rectangular prop (without real model silk print), the other hand slightly raised for gesturing an explanation
character.expression: Square-eyed smile, two darker voxel blocks on the brow to create thick eyebrows.

style.rendering: Minecraft voxel 3D, can have slight isometric perspective, blocks readable at 16px level
style.color_palette: Minecraft common 16-color extended green grass, light blue sky, dark gray voxel character clothing

background.type: Voxel grass block platform with simplified oak trees in the distance and low-polygon clouds

format.shape: Rounded Square Container with Embedded Pixelated Small Scene, or Entire Image in Pixel Format without UI

constraints.must_feel: A glance at a Minecraft style character that closely resembles the public's perception of Jensen Huang from press conferences, not a face swap
constraints.avoid: NVIDIA green label or actual company logo pixel block
